verdict.rationale: Stripe Agentic Commerce is an agent-facing commerce and payments platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer versioned, reviewable automations, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of versioning, change review, or rollback for automations. Nearby features do not count: the MCP human-approval gate is per-action confirmation, and catalog replace-mode imports permanently delete products rather than allow rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
